decisive_items: Multiple filamentous gram-positive bacilli identified on Gram stain
Recent activities included cleaning her fish tank, playing with her pet cat, and gardening in her indoor cactus garden
Dense neutrophilic infiltrate with associated tissue necrosis (Hematoxylin-eosin, original magnification ×20)
response.rationale: Filamentous gram-positive bacilli, tissue necrosis with neutrophilic inflammation, and exposure to soil/water sources strongly support Nocardia infection; the negative Ziehl-Neelsen, Fite, and PAS stains exclude other acid-fast and fungal organisms.
